_desc: Canned Response Library for NPC Dialogue
_note: Responses selected based on NPC personality + context

friendly: Hey there, friend! What brings you around?
Well hello! Haven't seen your face in a while.
Ah, a new face! Welcome to the neighborhood.
suspicious: Do I know you?
Who sent you?
Keep your hands where I can see them.

friendly: Take care out there!
See you around, friend.
Stay safe! The streets are rough.
Yeah, the {weather} again. At least we're not in the Outzone!
This {weather} keeps the Temple patrols inside. Good for business.
I actually like the {weather}. Reminds me of home.
neutral: Just another day in the city.
Weather's weather. Doesn't change much down here.
pessimist: This {weather} is gonna kill us all someday.
The acid levels are getting worse. I can taste it.
Remember when we had real sunlight? Me neither.

friendly: Can't complain! Well, I could, but who'd listen?
Living the dream. Or nightmare. Same thing here.
Better now that I've got someone to talk to!
depressed: Another day closer to the end.
I've seen better days. Much better days.
optimist: Great actually! Found some good salvage yesterday.
Things are looking up! The Resistance is gaining ground.
Better than most! Still breathing, still free.

friendly: The name's {npc_name}. And you are?
I'm {npc_name}. Nice to meet you!
{npc_name}. Most people just call me {nickname}.
suspicious: Why do you need to know?
That depends on who's asking.
{npc_name}. But if Temple is asking, I'm nobody.

friendly: {location}? Sure, head down {street} and take a left at the neon sign.
I can take you there if you want. It's not far.
{location} is in the {district}. Watch out for the patrols.
neutral: Two blocks east. Can't miss it.
In the {district}. Stay on the main roads.
suspicious: Why do you need to find {location}?
A lot of people looking for that place lately...
I might know. What's in it for me?

merchant: What are you looking for? I've got a bit of everything.
Browse all you want, just don't touch unless you're buying.
Best prices in the district! Well, the only prices in the district.
neutral: Might have some stuff. What do you need?
I could part with a few things. For the right price.
suspicious: This isn't that kind of establishment.
I don't know what you're talking about.
You wearing a wire? Get out.
greedy: Finally, a customer! Everything's on sale!
You look like someone with credits to spend.
Let me show you the premium goods...
That's rare. Gonna cost you {price} GEP. Maybe more.
For something like that? Let's start at {price} GEP.
friendly: For a friend? {price} GEP. I'm practically giving it away.
Tell you what, {price} GEP and I'll throw in some extras.
{price} GEP. That's the best I can do.

merchant: I could maybe do 10% off. Final offer.
You're killing me here. Fine. A small discount.
Alright, alright. I'll lower it a bit.
greedy: You think I'm running a charity?
Price is the price. Take it or leave it.
friendly: For you, I suppose I can work something out.
Tell you what - bring me more business and we'll talk.
Okay, okay. Special price just for you.
Word is, something big is going down in the Undercity.
You didn't hear this from me, but the Temple's been acting strange.
Rumor has it there's a new player in town. Someone powerful.
neutral: Same old, same old. Temple pushes, Resistance pushes back.
I keep my ears closed. Safer that way.
gossipy: Oh, have I got stories for you!
Did you hear about what happened at Merchant_01's bar?
Everyone's talking about the stranger who showed up last week...
suspicious: You ask a lot of questions.
I don't know anything. And neither do you.
Gossip gets people killed around here.

resistance_aligned: The Resistance? They're the only ones fighting for real freedom.
If you're looking to join, I might know someone...
Careful talking about them here. Walls have ears.
temple_aligned: The Temple maintains order. Without them, chaos.
Prophet Elijah saved this city. Remember that.
You should visit the District_D. Enlightening.
neutral: I stay out of faction politics. Healthier that way.
Both sides have their reasons. I have mine: survival.
Factions come and go. The city remains.
cynical: They're all the same. Different colors, same corruption.
Pick your poison. Temple or Resistance, you're still a pawn.
I stopped believing in causes a long time ago.

has_job: Actually, there is something... if you're up for it.
I might have something. Pays well, but it's risky.
You look capable. I need someone to handle a... situation.
no_job: Nothing right now. Check back later.
I don't have work, but Merchant_01 at the bar might.
Jobs are scarce these days. Everyone's looking.
suspicious: Work? What kind of work?
I don't hire strangers.
Come back when you've earned some trust.

helpful: Watch yourself in the {location}. Temple patrols have doubled.
{location}'s not safe after dark. Trust me.
If you're heading to {location}, avoid the main entrance.
neutral: Everywhere's dangerous. You get used to it.
Keep your head down and you'll be fine. Probably.
Danger? This whole city is danger.
ominous: There are things worse than Temple patrols out there...
Some dangers you can see. Others... you only feel when it's too late.
The walls whisper sometimes. I'd listen if I were you.

friendly: Thanks! That means a lot.
You really think so? That's sweet of you.
Well aren't you a charmer!
suspicious: What do you want?
Flattery won't get you anywhere.
Save it. What's your angle?
shy: That's... that's very kind of you.
I... I don't know what to say...

aggressive: You want to say that again?
You just made a big mistake.
neutral: That's nice. Are we done here?
Your opinion means nothing to me.
I've been called worse. By better people.
hurt: Fine. See if I help you again.
witty: Big words from someone in your position.
Is that the best you've got? I've heard better insults from children.
And yet here I am, still standing. Funny how that works.

friendly: Happy to help! Anytime.
That's what neighbors are for.
Don't mention it. Really, don't. It might get me in trouble.
suspicious: Just remember you owe me one.
Save your thanks. We're even.
Don't get too comfortable. This was a one-time thing.

friendly: Hey, no worries! We all make mistakes.
It's okay. Water under the bridge.
Already forgotten. Let's move on.
neutral: Just don't let it happen again.

knowledgeable: Echoes? You've felt them too? The whispers between layers...
Some say the Echoes are fragments of souls. Others say data.
The layers are real. I've seen things... between.
superstitious: Don't speak of such things! You'll attract attention.
The Echoes are sacred. Or cursed. Nobody knows which.
I heard someone touched an Echo once. They're still screaming.
skeptical: Echoes are just glitches. Radiation damage. Nothing more.
You believe in that multiverse nonsense?

default: You'll have to be more specific.
I don't understand what you're asking.

add_to_response: Pretend we're not talking about that.
At least it's not acid rain... yet.
